enemyEditor.announceBtn: To get the specific resistance values of enemies, please visit the wiki.
enemyEditor.note: Note: Genshin Impact halves resistance shred values below 0%. For the sake of calculations enter the RAW value and Stellar Optimizer will do the rest. (e.g. 10% - 20% = -10%)

fight.valiantStellar: {{count}} Valiant Assaults of ≈ {{seconds}} s: its shield takes the damage, and its 600 Courage drains 15/s, {{courage}}/s more from the team’s Electro hits ({{stellar}} Stellar Glimmer hits/s)
fight.valiantCourage: {{count}} Valiant Assaults of ≈ {{seconds}} s: its shield takes the damage, and its 600 Courage drains 15/s, {{courage}}/s more from the team’s Electro hits
fight.valiantNoGauge: {{count}} Valiant Assaults of ≈ {{seconds}} s: its shield takes the damage, and its 600 Courage drains 15/s
fight.radianceDrinks: {{count}} drinks under Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: 540 Courage, not 600 (its Valiant Assault waits for its next drink, the team’s Electro hits wearing it down in between)
fight.backlashStellar: Backlash on leaving them: 60% of the DMG its shield took (150% of the Stellar Glimmer DMG), at most 15% of its HP each: {{hp}} of its HP
fight.horns: {{count}} pairs of horns (+150% RES), ≈ {{seconds}} s each to break ({{removal}} gauge/s of reactions on their 64U Pyro)
fight.hornsKept: Its horns (+150% RES) stay on for the {{time}}: not broken in time
fight.hornsBreak: Each break: 10% of its HP ({{hp}} in all), then 10 s without horns
fight.custom: {{time}} at {{dps}} DPS (its HP ÷ the team’s DPS)
fight.anchors: {{count}} Vagrant Reverberations: its Moonstone Anchor’s ward (9 layers of 4U Geo) takes the damage for ≈ {{seconds}} s each, its HP untouched
fight.anchorsKept: {{count}} Vagrant Reverberations: its Moonstone Anchor’s ward (9 layers of 4U Geo) is not broken in its 35 s, its HP untouched, then the Anchor blasts the team (200% ATK Geo DMG) and its next cocoon raises all its RES
fight.wardBreak: Each ward broken: 70% of the Geo DMG the Anchor took and 10% of the rest, at most 40% of its HP, then 4.4 s stunned: {{hp}} of its HP in all
fight.cocoon: {{count}} Radiant Cocoons on the team (−100% CRIT Rate, −50% DMG Bonus; +60% Geo RES on it), each healed out {{healed}} s after its roar: {{time}} in all
fight.cocoonKept: {{count}} Radiant Cocoons on the team (−100% CRIT Rate, −50% DMG Bonus; +60% Geo RES on it), never healed out: {{time}} in all, until each next Anchor
fight.disentangled: Disentangled (+15% CRIT Rate, +50% DMG Bonus) for 15 s after each: {{time}} in all

note.sip: Not counted: after a drink cut short, its next one has a 50% chance to be a sip of 189 Courage (a full drink counted)
note.noRotation: No written rotation: the team’s element applications are not known (none counted)
note.electroEstimated: No written rotation: its Electro hits are taken from the attacks entered (Stellar Glimmer DMG: Cyno’s, Mitya’s, Yae’s; of the others every 3rd applying 1U, as the standard ICD lets it)
note.electroStun: Not counted: the stun Electro hits build up to (it delays its drinks)
note.noHornRemoval: No Hydro, Electro, Cryo, Anemo or Geo applied: its horns are never broken
note.crabs: Not counted: its Sternshield Crabs (their Pyro takes the same reactions; their slam, up to 15% of its HP)
note.wardEstimated: Ward time from the written rotation: its Blunt hits’ poise (claymores, plunges, most Geo attacks) and its other melee hits’, 100 or 50 where a kit does not give it. Set your own in the enemy box.
note.wardAssumed: Ward time assumed ({{seconds}} s): no written rotation to read it from. Set your own in the enemy box.
note.wardSet: Ward time and healing as set in the enemy box
note.noHealer: No healer: the team stays in its Radiant Cocoon until the next Anchor
note.opening: Its first rotation is counted without Bursts: the fight starts with no energy (set in the enemy box)
note.cocoonApprox: The team’s DPS in its cocoon and Disentangled is still being worked out: its own DPS counted for now
note.mechanics: Its HP ÷ the team’s DPS: its mechanics are not counted

buildInfo.equipped: This is the build currently equipped to your character, this represents in-game equipment and is persistent outside of the Loadout.
buildInfo.build: A Build is comprised of a weapon and 5 artifacts.
buildInfo.tcbuild: A Theorycraft Build allows defining a build by raw stats.

buildTcCharOverride.tip: Set a specific level, constellation, ascension, or talent level for this TC build, that is different from the base character
buildTcCharOverride.btn: Override Character Data for This TC build

tcNoOptimize.title: This loadout is using a theorycraft build
tcNoOptimize.description: The optimizer and the artifact upgrader search the artifacts you own, so they need a real build. Switch this loadout to its equipped build to use them; your theorycraft build is kept and can be picked again from the build menu above.

teamOpt.desc: Builds for the whole team at once. Every member’s attacks in one rotation count, with the buffs the members give each other, and no artifact is used twice: a support gets the set and stats that help the team most.

editor.buffsHint: Each buff shows what it gives and how much more damage this attack deals with it. Untick one that is not up during this attack, pick another of its states, or limit it to the first hits (e.g. Shenhe’s quills).
editor.hitsHint: Casts or hits in one rotation; averages like 2.5 are fine.
editor.impact: What the buff adds to this attack’s damage
editor.limitHint: Up for the first hits only (e.g. quills). All hits by default.
editor.noBuffs: No conditional buffs are on in this team. Turn them on in Team settings or on each character’s tabs.
editor.onField: On the field during these hits
editor.onFieldHint: Buffs for the active character (e.g. Mitya’s C1) go to whoever is on the field. Pick another member for hits that land while they are, e.g. a skill that keeps hitting after a switch.
editor.stateHint: Its state during this attack. The rotation’s is the one set in Team settings or on the character’s tabs.
editor.extraHint: Bonus stats for this attack only: a buff the game data does not have, or your own numbers. For the whole rotation, use Extra buffs.
editor.impactDetail: One hit: {{with}} with this buff, {{without}} without
editor.neededDetail: The attack deals no damage without it: {{with}} per hit with it
editor.allIdle: None of the team’s buffs changes this attack’s damage.
editor.unusedHint: Passives of weapons and artifact sets the member does not have on now, and effects that are not unlocked. A weapon’s or set’s passive counts once Team Optimize picks it for the member.
editor.critCapped: CRIT Rate is {{value}} without it: already over the 100% cap
editor.hitsPlayedHint: Its hits in one rotation, as the rotation was played for these builds.
editor.buffsPlayedHint: The buffs as the rotation was played for these builds: what each gives and how much more damage this attack deals with it.
editor.noBuffsShort: No buffs are on in this team
editor.unusedLockedHint: Effects that are not unlocked: a constellation the member does not have, or a resonance the team does not have.
editor.sharedImpact: It works only together with the buff above: without either one, the same damage is lost ({{with}} per hit with both, {{without}} without). Not extra damage on top.
editor.lowersDetail: Less damage on this attack with it: {{with}} per hit, {{without}} without.
editor.lowersTrade: It lowers {{lowered}} and raises {{raised}}, which this attack does not use.
editor.lowersUntick: Untick it if it is not up during these hits.
editor.hitStatsHint: One hit of this attack with the buffs as they are set: the character’s stats during it, as this hit uses them (CRIT Rate with the element’s, DMG Bonus with the talent’s…), and what each adds up, with where it comes from. The ? on a row shows its formula.
editor.enemyHint: The enemy this hit lands on: its level, its DEF lowered or ignored (and the DEF multiplier that leaves), and its RES with what lowers it.
editor.ignoresDef: This hit ignores enemy DEF, as reaction damage does.
editor.momentHint: When this hit lands in the rotation
editor.checkingBuffs: Checking each buff on this attack… {{done}}/{{total}}
editor.autoTip: Set automatically for this rotation and team. Choose a state on the character’s weapon or artifacts to use another one.
editor.useAutoTip: Set by hand. Let Team optimize decide it for this rotation and team instead.

result.saveHint: A new build per member, used by this team. Nothing moves between characters.
result.unmetWhy: No build reaches it with this member’s settings: its main stats, the sets it may use, the artifact levels and the weapons ticked. This build gets the closest. Lower the requirement, or allow more.
result.unmetKept: Kept as it is: its build does not reach it.
result.equipWarn_one: Equips the new build on 1 member (a saved build is updated instead). Artifacts move from whoever wears them now.

result.share: Its share of the team’s damage
result.shareDps: Its share of the team’s DPS
result.untickedWeapon: Not ticked: kept, no ticked weapon was free
result.hitsTitle: Damage per hit, in the rotation
result.stale: Found with an earlier rotation or settings: what changed since is not in it.
result.belowNowSets_one: can’t keep their current build: it breaks their allowed sets (Requirements → Artifact sets)
result.belowNowSets_other: can’t keep their current builds: they break their allowed sets (Requirements → Artifact sets)
result.belowNowWeapons_one: can’t keep their current weapon: it isn’t ticked in Weapons to choose from

result.excludedToast: Excluded from this team. Run again to find builds without it.
result.timelineTip: The written rotation as these builds play it: each member’s actions and swaps, with these weapons and artifact sets. Pick an attack to see its damage and the buffs during it.

rotation.empty: No attacks yet. A support without attacks still counts through the buffs it gives.
rotation.info: Add each member’s attacks and how often they hit in one rotation. The buffs are the ones that are on in Team settings and on the characters’ tabs: open an attack to turn off one that is not up during it, to put it in another state, or to limit one to its first hits (Shenhe’s quills, a buff that runs out).
rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.memberShareTip: DPS, and its share of the team’s damage

run.allKept: Every member’s build is kept: nothing to optimize.
run.allMembersKept: Every member is kept: nothing to optimize.
run.searchTip: Quick narrows each slot to the artifacts that can matter and searches in full only the weapons a quick estimate puts near the best: much faster, and it rarely misses the best build (by a little when it does). Full searches every artifact and every weapon.
run.how: Each member is optimized in turn for the whole rotation’s damage, the others fixed, the biggest damage dealer first. Rounds repeat until no build changes; then members trade pieces and weapons where the team gains.
run.setRulesUnmet: No team build fits the allowed sets of
run.setRulesUnmetWhy: Even with the pieces the other members hold, no build of the artifacts they may use keeps to the sets allowed on their Optimize tab (Requirements → Artifact sets), with their main stats and the inventory settings. Allow more sets, or free up pieces of the sets they need.
run.noTeam: The team could not be computed.
run.allTc: Every member uses a TC build, which Team optimize keeps as it is. Switch members to their equipped builds, or use KQM Theorycrafting.
run.allSwitchedOff: Every member is switched off: turn members on in Optimize team.
run.keepNeedsOriginal: Run the original first: this version keeps its teammates' gear from the original's result.
run.requirementsUnmet: The search did not find a build that meets the minimums for
run.requirementsUnmetWhy: The search uses the allowed sets, main stats, artifact levels and weapons. To change a manual minimum, open the member’s Optimize tab.
run.automaticErShortfall: Automatic ER gets its target from the team’s ER calculator. It can change with the rotation and the team’s weapons.

teamOpt.title: Team optimize

weapons.title: Weapons to choose from
weapons.desc: Each member tries the ticked weapons of its type, along with its artifacts. A passive counts only when it is on for that character. An energy weapon in the team lowers each member’s Energy Recharge requirement by what you set for that member: click ⚡ on it.
weapons.passiveHint: Saved on each character’s loadout: its pages use the same settings.
weapons.energyHint: Gives energy or particles: click to set how much less Energy Recharge each member needs with it in the team.
weapons.energySetHint: Less Energy Recharge each member needs while someone in the team wields it. Click to change.
weapons.energyAdd: Gives energy? Set how much less Energy Recharge each member needs
weapons.teamEnergyHint: How much less Energy Recharge each member needs while someone in the team wields this weapon.
weapons.noEnergyNeedHint: : no Energy Recharge requirement, so this changes nothing yet
weapons.tooFewTicked: Tick one for each member: a member left without one keeps its current weapon.

onField.label: On field
onField.info: Who is on the field during the rotation’s hits, unless an attack says otherwise (open it to change it). Buffs for the active character, like Mitya’s C1 CRIT DMG, go to them, and the ones for off-field characters to the others. Elsewhere the app counts the team’s first member as on the field.

extra.title: Extra buffs
extra.info: Buffs the game data does not have, like food, an Abyss blessing or your own numbers. For the whole team or one member: they count on its hits and in its stats and requirements.
extra.zero: At 0 it does nothing: enter its value.

transfer.title: Import a team rotation
transfer.desc: Paste a rotation exported from Team optimize. The members in it get its attacks; the others keep theirs.
transfer.label: Rotation JSON
transfer.invalid: This is not a team rotation export.

rotationTime.label: Rotation time
rotationTime.info: How long one rotation takes, for the DPS. Saved for this team.

sens.title: What raises team damage
sens.info: Each cell: the team’s rotation damage with that one change on that member, against the result above (same rotation, buffs, artifacts and weapons). A roll is an average 5★ roll, as in the Improve tab’s Substat value.
sens.infoKqm: Each cell: the team’s rotation damage with that one change on that member’s KQM build, against the builds above (same rotation, buffs and weapons). A roll is a KQM Standard roll (0.8 of it on a 4★ piece); talents and levels go up from KQM’s.
sens.readSubstat: How to read it: one extra {{stat}} roll on <name/>’s artifacts raises the team’s damage by {{value}}.
sens.readTalent: How to read it: one more {{talent}} level on <name/> raises the team’s damage by {{value}}.
sens.readLevel: How to read it: <name/> at level {{level}} raises the team’s damage by {{value}}.

runDialog.title: Optimize team
runDialog.sizeHint: Builds to search: the combinations of the artifacts a member may use with these settings (sets not counted). Fewer main stats make it smaller, so the run faster.
runDialog.mainStatsHint: The main stats it may use per slot (none ticked: any). The same settings as its Optimize tab.
runDialog.emptySlots: No artifacts to choose from for: {{slots}}. Turn on Other characters’ artifacts or allow lower levels.

card.title: Team card
card.erNote: Out-of-combat stats: no conditional effects or teammates. The ER in the table is the rotation's.

kqm.staleShort: Setup changed. Run again to refresh.
kqm.artifactTotalsTip: All five artifacts: main stats + 2 fixed rolls per substat + 20 distributed rolls. Excludes character, weapon and set bonuses. Hover a stat for its breakdown.
kqm.linkedCompareTip: Choose a set to re-rank weapons, or a weapon to re-rank sets. Main stats and substats are optimized again. Teammates keep the builds from this run.
kqm.catchUpTip: Greedy estimate of extra average rolls above the 20-roll KQM budget, with the same equipment, main stats and teammates. Per-stat placement caps and ER requirements still apply. No match means the search could not close the gap within 20 extra rolls.
kqm.catchUpHeader: Each row shows the extra substats needed to match the row immediately above it. Hover the roll estimate to see the stat amounts.
kqm.buttonInfo: Compare weapons and artifact sets using KQM builds at C6 for 4★ characters and C0 for 5★ characters.
kqm.compareInfo: The team’s damage with each set (and the best weapon), and with each weapon (and the best sets), for this member: its main stats and rolls chosen again each time, the others’ builds as they are.
kqm.info: KQM builds use C6 for 4★ characters and C0 for 5★ characters, selected level 90 weapons and five 5★ artifacts at +20. Each build has 2 fixed rolls of every substat and 20 optimized rolls. Your rotation, main stat filters and requirements apply.
kqm.resultInfo: Level 90, C6 for 4★ and C0 for 5★, 10/10/10 base talents plus constellation bonuses. Five +20 artifacts: 2 fixed rolls of each substat and 20 distributed rolls, with at most 2 distributed rolls per eligible piece per stat. Selected equipment, ER targets and team rotation settings apply.
kqm.title: KQM builds
kqm.tooFewTicked: Select at least one weapon of this type before generating builds.
kqm.unmetWhy: No KQM build reaches it with this member’s main stats and allowed sets. This build gets the closest.
kqm.setupIntro: Compare weapons and artifact sets for your rotation using KQM Standards artifacts.
kqm.weaponSummary: Defaults: R5 craftable, event, fishing and 4★ standard wish weapons; R1 Battle Pass and rewards. Event wish, 5★ standard wish and Starglitter weapons start off.
kqm.setSummary: Choose which sets to compare and configure their effects for each member. Each member’s existing set rules still apply.
kqm.refinementHelp: Craftable, event and fishing weapons default to R5; Battle Pass and one-copy rewards to R1. Each weapon’s own refinement setting takes priority.
kqm.noMembers: Select at least one member in Setup.
kqm.missingWeapons: Select at least one weapon for each selected member in Weapons.
kqm.compareHelp: Each row shows the whole team’s damage when this member’s weapon or set changes. Main stats and rolls are optimized again; other members keep the builds shown above. Percentages are relative to the best team build found.
kqm.weaponHelp: Select weapons to compare. Adjust refinement, effects and energy contribution below each weapon.
kqm.noMatches: No matches. Change the search or turn off Selected only.
kqm.setHelp: Choose sets and configure their effects for each member. Their existing set rules still apply. Clear all to compare without a set bonus.
kqm.noSets: No artifact sets selected. Builds will have no set bonus.

calc.active: Calculator targets applied. ER is recalculated for each weapon choice during optimization. Editing a target switches back to manual ER requirements.
calc.title: Calculate the team’s ER needs
calc.intro: Confirm skill uses, particle catching and field time for one rotation. ER is calculated for the whole team, then applied to KQM. Extra energy from abilities or effects goes in Bonus flat energy.
calc.globalHelp: Enemy clear particles are the total neutral particles dropped over the chamber clear time. Electro resonance particles require two Electro teammates; their interval is at least 5 seconds.
calc.memberHelp: Set rotations per burst to 0 if the burst is unused. Turret particles are distributed by field time. Confirm any energy refunds from character passives in Bonus flat energy.
calc.advanced: Secondary skill, Favonius and bonus energy
calc.weaponHelp: The preview counts Favonius and flat-energy weapon triggers for members who may use such a weapon here. During optimization they follow each build’s weapon and refinement. Supported flat-energy weapons: Amenoma, Kitain, Katsuragikiri, Prototype Amber and Everlasting Moonglow. For other effects, include only bonus energy that applies to every build you compare. ER reductions entered in the Weapons window are not applied again.
calc.breakdown: {{particles}} particle energy at 100% ER + {{flat}} flat energy per rotation; burst cost {{cost}}.
calc.flatTip: Energy per rotation from character abilities or effects shared by every build. From a written rotation it includes the random Energy of the member’s Normal and Charged Attack hits.
calc.clearTip: How long the chamber takes: the enemy particles below drop over this time.
calc.enemyTip: Neutral particles the enemies drop over the clear time.
calc.electroTip: Electro resonance particles (two Electro members): one every this many seconds, at least 5. 0: none.
calc.editedTip: You changed some of these inputs, so the written rotation no longer fills them in. Use the rotation’s values again.
calc.fromRotationTip: Field time, skill uses, Burst cadence and the particle catcher come from the written rotation (particles count when they arrive, about 1.7 s after the hit). Change any of them to set it yourself.
calc.secondaryTip: Another way the skill is used in the rotation (hold and press, another form), with its own uses.
calc.shortBurstTip: {{name}} per rotation: a Burst that spends 30 Energy.
calc.fullWithShortTip: This rotation uses the full Burst as well as {{name}}, so the ER needed counts its full Energy cost too. Usually only {{name}} is played: set Burst to Unused if that full Burst is not meant (for Flins, a Q before his E or after Manifest Flame has ended).
calc.fieldTimeTip: Share of the rotation this member is on the field (the others share the rest). Turret particles and catching follow it.
calc.catcherTip: Who is on the field when this member’s skill particles arrive; the % beside it is how many go there (Fed to catcher), the rest to this member.
calc.favProcsTip: Per rotation, while this member holds a Favonius weapon (KQM counts them for each weapon it tries). Each makes 3 clear particles: 6 Energy for the catcher, less for the others. At most one per 12 s (R1) to 6 s (R5).
calc.favoniusIfHeld: Counted for the builds that hold a Favonius weapon, not in the estimate above.
calc.weaponTriggersTip: Per rotation, while this member holds an energy weapon other than Favonius (Lumidouce Elegy, Dialogues of the Desert Sages…): the energy follows the weapon and its refinement, at most once per its cooldown. Frostbreath's goes to the other members. Prototype Amber counts by itself, once per Burst.

kqm.erHelp: Total ER% each member needs, or calculate it for this rotation. 100% (the default) means no extra ER. The optimizer meets ER first, then uses the remaining rolls for damage.
kqm.erAllocate: Rolls allocated to meet this target
kqm.standardTip: KQM Standards: 2 fixed rolls of every substat + 20 distributed rolls. Base talents are 10/10/10, with constellation bonuses. Enemy and rotation settings follow this team.

share.investSubtitle: The best team DPS at each cost · {{standard}}
share.investNote: Cost counts copies: a 5★ is 1 at C0, and every constellation is 1 more. Each row is the best way to spend it.
share.comboPick: Raise at least two members above the run’s constellations.
share.comboEdit: Edit the rotation for this combination
share.tipBody: A team card, and weapon, artifact set and constellation charts, as images for Discord, Reddit or X.
share.comboTip: When several members’ constellations change the rotation together (one member’s C2 with another’s C1), write the rotation for that combination. It is used for those constellations and any higher ones; otherwise a combination plays the first member’s rotation for its constellation, else the team’s.
share.investRunning: Finding the best constellations for cost {{cost}} of {{costs}}

kqm.betaTip: New and still being refined: results may change between versions.
kqm.groupBpTip: The Battle Pass’s weapon choice (Gnostic Hymn). On by default at R1.
kqm.groupWish4Tip: Only from a weapon banner’s rate-up (event wishes), and the Starglitter shop. Off by default.
kqm.groupStandard4Tip: The standard wish pool’s 4★ (Favonius, Sacrificial…), from any banner. On by default at R5.
kqm.groupStandard5Tip: The standard banner’s 5★ (Skyward, Aquila Favonia, Wolf’s Gravestone…). Off by default.
kqm.groupWish5Tip: Only from a weapon banner’s rate-up (event wishes). Off by default. Free 5★ weapons (Exaiphanes Blade) are always on, at R1.
kqm.compareScopeTip: The weapons and artifact sets the builds may use. Each one is ranked in the results.
kqm.outOfReachTip: Even with the most rolls each substat can take, it does not match #1.
kqm.behindTip: Average substat rolls on top of the KQM budget, same teammates. ER requirements and per-substat caps still apply.
kqm.vsBestHeaderTip: How many extra substat rolls each option needs to match #1.
kqm.membersAllHelp: Every member gets a KQM Standards build at the constellation shown: level 90, the talent levels set here, five +20 artifacts with 2 fixed rolls per substat and {{rolls}} rolls placed for damage.
kqm.talentsTip: Every member’s talent levels (normal attack, skill, burst; constellations add theirs on top). KQM’s guides compare at 9/9/9; 10/10/10 is with Crowns.
kqm.consTip: Constellation of this KQM build. KQM standard: C6 for 4★, C0 for 5★.
kqm.subtitle: Standard KQM builds for this rotation: level 90, 4★ C6 / 5★ C0, the talent levels set below, five +20 artifacts with 2 fixed rolls per substat and {{rolls}} rolls placed for damage.
kqm.rotationPlayedTip: The written rotation played for these builds: at these constellations, with their weapons and artifact sets, 4 rotations in a row with the last 2 averaged, at the pace it can keep.
kqm.stallsTip: Played several times in a row, the rotation reaches these before they are ready again, and waits each time (its time and DPS include the wait). Write them with a ? to use them only when ready ("Sucrose N1 E? D"), or use something else there (a Charged Attack).
kqm.threadsTip: Background threads that build the team’s formulas during a run. More finish sooner; each uses about 200 MB of memory while a run lasts. Auto picks from this device’s memory and cores.
kqm.preliminaryTip: The best builds found so far. The run is still trying better weapons, sets and teammates’ builds: the figures, builds and rankings here can still change, and update when it finds better ones.
kqm.runWithTip: The setup these builds were made with. A value after → is what it is now: run again to use it.
kqm.standardDetail: {{rolls}} rolls, at most {{cap}} a piece per stat
kqm.topBuildsTip: The best builds, then the best that change one member’s weapon or artifact sets. Pick one to see it.
kqm.fourStarTip_one: {{count}} of the five artifacts is 4★ (this set’s pieces). By KQM Standards a 4★ piece has a +16 main stat, 0.8 of a 5★ piece’s substats and 2 fewer distributed rolls: this build places {{rolls}}.
kqm.fourStarTip_other: {{count}} of the five artifacts are 4★ (this set’s pieces). By KQM Standards a 4★ piece has a +16 main stat, 0.8 of a 5★ piece’s substats and 2 fewer distributed rolls: this build places {{rolls}}.
kqm.shareTip: How the team’s damage splits: by who deals it, and by the element it deals (a reaction’s damage counts as its element, Lunar-Charged as Electro).

frames.title: Frame data
frames.intro: gcsim’s frame data for each character (60 frames = 1 s). Change any value to match how you play; the rotation time, auras, buffs and hits recalculate. Character edits are saved for every team.
frames.pingTip: Your ping sets the swap time: a swap waits for the server to answer, so it takes about twice your ping (100 ms ≈ 12 frames, KQM standard; 30 ms ≈ 4). Attacks, Skills and Bursts are not delayed by ping.
frames.useKqmSwap: Use KQM standard (12 frames, about 100 ms)
frames.stepsHint: When each action starts; change one step without changing the character
frames.charactersHint: Each character’s frames for every action, saved for every team
frames.noSteps: Write a rotation to see its steps.
frames.noKit: No frame data for this character yet: their actions are not simulated.
frames.lengthTip: How long the action takes. Changing it moves all its cancels by the same amount. Open an action (▾) to set each cancel on its own.
frames.hitDelayTip: Frames added before each of the action’s hits lands (travel time, a later hitmark). The next action is not delayed.
frames.cancelsHint: Frames until each next action can start. Greyed ones have no cancel of their own and wait the full length.

timing.swapTip: Frames from pressing a character’s key until they are on the field and can act, for every swap. KQM standard: 12 frames.
timing.rotationsTip: Repeating: the pace the rotation keeps when played over and over, as KQM counts it (a cooldown not ready in time waits). From the start: only the first 1 to 6 rotations, with every cooldown ready at the start, as in a timed challenge. Team optimize and KQM use the same choice.
timing.openerCountedTip: Your “First rotation only” (in the rotation writer). On: it is the first rotation, and counted. Off: played before the start as a setup and not counted; its cooldowns, summons and auras carry into the rotations.
timing.swapCooldown: Waited {{seconds}} s for the swap cooldown

kind.chargedSpinsFinal_one: Charged attack, {{count}} spin and the finisher

timing.startTip: When the action starts, in seconds from the start of the rotation.
timing.framesTip: Frames until the next action can start. Lower it for a faster cancel, raise it for slower play or a pause. Hits already started still land on time.

writer.configureTip: Write the rotation and see its timeline, frame data and opener
writer.title: Write rotation
writer.help:
Who acts, then their actions, steps separated by ->:
E / tE skill (tap) · hE skill (hold) · Q burst · N1–N6 normal attacks · CA charged (Sandrone: 3 condensed beams, CA[beams=2] for 2, up to 6 from C1; Mavuika: C3F, 3 Flamestrider spins and the finisher) · P plunge · D dash · J jump · W1.5 wait 1.5 s (W90f: 90 frames) · E? Q? only when ready (left out, not waited for)
End with the first member ("-> bina") where the rotation loops.
Frame data: gcsim and kqmsim (AGPLv3). Mitya: E again within 6 s switches cores. Automatic entry skills are included. Unimplemented actions are listed below.
writer.openerTip: Your first rotation, when it differs from the rest (no Energy at the start, a setup skill). Played instead of the rotation the first time through. Counted from the start, it is the first rotation; repeating, it only sets up cooldowns, summons and auras and is not counted.
writer.openerCountedTip: Off: played before the start as a setup and not counted. Its cooldowns, summons and auras carry into the rotations.
writer.waitedTip: Played over and over, an action can still be on cooldown when the next rotation reaches it (for example a Burst used late in one rotation and early in the next): the rotation waits for it. Its first time through, nothing waits. Team optimize and KQM count the time per rotation, waits included.
writer.waitsRepeat: Waits for cooldowns from the previous rotation:

token.normal: Normal attacks: N1 to N6 hits
token.charged: Charged Attack (Sandrone: 3 condensed beams, CA[beams=2] for 2, up to 6 from C1; Mavuika: C3F spins 3 times, then the finisher)
token.wait: Wait: W1.5 is 1.5 s, W90f is 90 frames
token.swap: Swap in only: the member's swap-in effect and nothing else (an Entry Skill)

writer.subtitle: Who acts and what they do, step by step. The timeline and hits follow as you type.

syntax.step: A step: who acts, then their actions. Names can be short (bina, ei).
syntax.next: Next step. Also →, >, a comma or a new line.
syntax.normal: A normal attack string of that many hits
syntax.beams: Sandrone: release after 2 condensed beams (3 by default, up to 6 from C1)
syntax.spins: Mavuika: 3 Flamestrider spins, then the finisher · 2 spins, then a dash (no finisher)
syntax.repeat: A group that many times (up to 20), as N5 CD four times
syntax.ready: Only when ready: left out, not waited for
syntax.entry: Swap in only: the member's swap-in effect (a name alone mid-rotation is the same)
syntax.notes: Ignored · the first one is played
syntax.loop: End with the first member: where the rotation loops
syntax.credit: Automatic entry skills are included; actions not modelled are listed in the notes. Frame data: gcsim and kqmsim (AGPLv3).

start.heading: Set up the rotation
start.info: Write rotation: type it the way players do ("Bennett E Q -> …"); the attacks, hits and timing come from each kit. Add attacks: pick each member’s talents and hits by hand.

enemy.title: Enemy
enemy.hpTip: Its Max HP: how long the team takes to defeat it is its HP ÷ the team’s DPS (the rotation repeated). Type 20M, 1.5B or 20,000,000; empty: not counted.
enemy.defRedTip: DEF lowered by the team (Lisa’s A4, Zhongli’s… see each kit): the enemy’s DEF is multiplied by 1 − this.
enemy.defIgnTip: DEF ignored by the attacker (Raiden’s C2, Nahida’s C2…).
enemy.resTip: The enemy’s own RES, before the team’s shred (the calculation takes it off: below 0%, the game halves what is left; enter 10%, not −10%).
enemy.immuneOff: Immune: click to give it RES
enemy.immuneOn: Make it immune to this element
enemy.mechanicsScope: Time to defeat: Wavebinder’s and the Moongecko’s mechanics are modelled in full, the Emperor’s horns in part; other bosses are their HP ÷ the team’s DPS.
enemy.sources: Bosses, icons and descriptions: the game’s. HP and RES per phase:
enemy.setupTip: The builds are made for this enemy: its level and RES (a Stygian Onslaught boss sets them at once); its HP says how long they take to defeat it. It is the team’s, shared with Team optimize, KQM theorycrafting and the members’ own pages.
